home.heroTitle: Zeta Signals for XAU/USD with algorithmic precision.
home.heroBody: A signal platform for the gold market, built around H1 Bias, DXY, liquidity sweep and M5 execution. Everything is designed so an active signal is never confused with a historical position.
home.algoBody: Multi-layer data confluence reduces market noise and decision errors. The system only accepts setups that pass environment, liquidity and M5 confirmation filters.
home.storyTitle: From script to Zeta Signals platform
story: Zeta Signals was created to bring structure to gold-market decisions. Instead of reacting to every candle, the system builds higher-timeframe context, filters noise and allows only setups that make sense inside market structure and high-liquidity windows.

steps.title: Layer 1: H1 Bias
steps.body: Every signal starts with H1 trend analysis. The engine checks price position against EMA 200 and the Ichimoku Cloud. DXY analysis adds a safety filter that blocks risky setups. Execution only runs during liquidity windows: London (09:00-12:00) and New York (14:30-18:30).

steps.title: Layer 2: Liquidity Sweep
steps.body: The algorithm scans the last 24 hours of H1 structure for key highs and lows. A setup forms only after aggressive liquidity clearing and a quick return above or below the level within a maximum of 3 M5 candles.

steps.title: Layer 3: M5 Trigger
steps.body: The final signal appears after momentum confirmation through a Fair Value Gap or Engulfing formation supported by an RSI reversal. Stop Loss is anchored behind the liquidity-clearing candle and targets are based on RR plus the next H1 levels.

faq.q: Why are there no signals every few minutes?
faq.a: We prioritize quality over quantity. The system generates a signal only when H1 conditions, DXY correlation, liquidity window and M5 trigger align.

faq.q: Do I need an account with a specific broker?
faq.a: No. Signals are based on XAU/USD and can be used with any broker offering gold, although low latency and stable spreads are recommended.
Signal execution runs mainly during London and New York sessions. Outside these blocks, the system switches into monitoring mode.

dashboard.title: Zeta Signals - XAU/USD dashboard
dashboard.body: Gold is a market of exceptional liquidity and above-average volatility. The panel shows price, market status and realtime signals without page reloads.
notes: Only one active signal is available at a time, so stale entries never remain highlighted.
When TP, SL or time limit resolves a position, the backend sends a status update to every connected terminal.
The ticker, market badge and signal history are designed to make decisions fast, clear and unambiguous.
